task.pr_title: Allow LeanDataWriter to create zip files for futures data

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
`Compression.ZipCreateAppendData` won't update the entry if it already exists and log an error and return `false`. Believe this can happen if calling `Write(IEnumerable<BaseData> source)`, they don't seem to be removing the entry if it exists as `DownloadAndSave()` is, this seems in part to the code duplication we have here 😅  - Maybe we can add an override argument to `Compression.ZipCreateAppendData`. Thoughts @Jay-Jay-D
Think we are missing some tests for covering this behavior too 😢
